fragmentation_risks.summary: Package, gate, and delegated/LM package concepts exist in multiple SQLite stores and generated contracts.
Operator events, conversation history, sentinels, and service status stores can drift if treated as separate truth stores.
Request/response and review status appears across bridge files, package queue state, and invoice-review state.
Generated system-knowledge databases should remain read-model/evidence stores until canonical ownership is declared.
Test harness and pytest databases are numerous and should be excluded from production consolidation.
Business ledger databases must not be mixed with package, test, or agent-state consolidation.

purpose: Read-only map of OpenClaw's agentic message/gate/package/worker/receipt chain and SQLite inventory.

recommendations.recommendation: Create a single package-event index that references workflow_package_queue, request/response receipts, and operator_conversation_journal without moving business ledger data.
Keep .openclaw/business_ops/ledger.sqlite and all ledger backups out of package/agent consolidation.
Keep token_vault and privacy stores isolated; reference only protected hashes or token refs.
Treat .openclaw/test_harness and .openclaw/tmp pytest databases as read-only evidence or disposable fixtures, not production truth.
Do not merge generated status databases until each has a declared canonical owner and migration target.
Never mix business ledger truth with agent memory, package queues, test harnesses, or generated read-model status stores.
